items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I see that Parnassie -- we mentioned all the ones with Lunceford except Wham. He mentioned Wham was one of the Lunceford's. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that was originally made for Benny Moten.

ctx.x: and got there, and they was already in rehearsal, out at the park. And I went out there and I had -- couldn't make no score because I didn't have time. I wanted to have something in rehearsal. And Harry Edison, those guys sat down and -- I made some score and they struck it off. And that's why they -- all embarrass Edgar so when they see him, because they wonder, how did he get on this sort of music?
I see that Parnassie -- we mentioned all the ones with Lunceford except Wham. He mentioned Wham was one of the Lunceford's.
Yeah, that was originally made for Benny Moten.
